session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bear Trend Trending Trading Range'. Reading: open near 6301 with a small double bottom/wedge, then a bear trend under the EMA: parabolic wedge minor reversal at the 6284 low gives one weak breakout attempt (possible bull trap before Leg 1 to 6260), a surprise bear breakout expects a 2nd leg down, a tight micro channel down and a triangle final flag sets up Leg 2 to 6250, and the late-in-channel breakout is flagged as possible exhaustion. EOD turns into chop with a LH after the reversal attempt and a double bottom bull flag into the close near 6270. Plain-PT axis (7/7 08:45-15:00, 7/8 edge marker). 'Bear Trend Trending Trading Range' = trending_trading_range; filename agrees.
